nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Watergel Sheet Ampoule Mask

avis.texte: They work well but they are nothing too exciting compared to others. Wish they stayed on better but work well for what they are supposed to do.

I really like this mask, Chat GPT helped me choose this based on ingredients that WORK. Got this for soothing irritation, calming. I have very reactive red skin. I find this mask very soothing and skin looks and feels great afterward. Highly recommend
So moisturizing. I leave it on for up to an hour, then squeeze out the remaining contents of the package and put that on as well. These have the most product of any sheet mask I’ve ever used.
I used for my sensitive skin. It helped me to improve dermatitis without make my skin more sensible. I think it’s a good value for money!

Love these soooooooo much! I am a sheet mask addict and these are probably my new favorite. Using these converted me to expanding my use to other SKIN1004 products. There is so much product in the packet - you could almost refold the sheet mask and seal it back in the pouch and use a second time. The mask itself is a thicker texture - not thicker bad - just meaning not flimsy. Feels great and soothing when I wear it. Fantastic price. I am on my 3rd or 4th repurchase on Amazon.
Lo vi en un post de mi dermatologa y lo compre para probarlo, me gusto mucho, es facil de colocar, es refrescante y me dejo una sensacion de suavidad en la piel.
Love those korean facial mask. So hydrating, perfect size for the face, and no odor. Love it

To be honest, this sheet masks works great! I use this every time my skin feels dehydrated and this really softens and exfoliates my skin. I’m only giving it 2 stars because I’ve had issues purchasing the BOX of this product which should come with 5 pieces of sheet masks… I’ve tried purchasing the box ($12) which should come with 5 sheet masks twice and both times It only came with 1 piece of sheet mask. Not sure what’s going on but they need to fix this ASAP !
